title: JobPosting
description: One job posting record. Both team members (JSearch / Headcount Labs) must output exactly this shape.

job_title.description: Title exactly as written in the posting.

location.description: City as given in the posting, e.g. 'Riyadh'. null if missing.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'SA'. Lets you filter Saudi postings.

specialization.description: Primary specialization, one of the 9 target areas. Postings that fit none of them are discarded before validation, not stored.

required_skills.description: Skills extracted by the LLM. Title Case, one skill per item, e.g. ['Python', 'SQL', 'Docker'].

description.description: Full original posting text. Keep it so skills can be re-extracted without calling the API again.

publisher.description: Site the posting was originally published on (e.g. LinkedIn, Bayt), when the API provides it.
